title: High No-Show Risk on This Week's Booked Visits
description: 53 of the 200 booked visits on the schedule carry a high no-show risk from their pattern profile — prior no-shows, long travel, or slow reminder response. Per the reminder rules, these patients get touches at 72, 24, and 3 hours on their preferred channel, and the 24-hour reminder offers telehealth where the visit is eligible.

title: Open Telehealth Slots While Long-Drive Visits Hold
description: 39 telehealth slots are open across nearby clinics while patients with more than an hour's drive hold in-person bookings for telehealth-eligible visit reasons. Offering the switch in the 24-hour reminder converts wasted trips into kept visits.

title: Coverage Checks Coming Back Inactive
description: Only 41 of 200 eligibility checks returned active coverage this cycle. Per the exception flow, booking still completes for lapsed patients — the appointment is flagged and the patient is routed to an enrollment assister, so a coverage lapse never blocks care.
